text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Huh? You've never heard of turf
fortune-telling?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
You're supposed to count the grass
blades as you
run and say "They love
me. They love me not."

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I wanna try it during our next training
session! ♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Trainer loves me. Trainer loves me not...
Just
kidding. ☆
